scopeAsStated: gallium production plant co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery
statementOriginal: The ceremony marked the start of construction of the new facility co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery in Western Australia.
statementEn: The ceremony marked the start of construction of the new facility co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery in Western Australia.
note: Alcoa reports that the August 24, 2026 groundbreaking ceremony marked the start of construction; Australian ministers describe the first sod turned. This candidate records the reported ceremony only, not independently observed sustained works, cash disbursement, commissioning or production.

locator: Opening sentence of the 8 October 2026 ministerial media release
statementOriginal: Construction of a globally significant rare earths project has now commenced in the heart of the nation.
statementEn: Construction of a globally significant rare earths project has now commenced in the heart of the nation.
note: Australian Government ministerial statement published 8 October 2026. The 8 October groundbreaking/release date is kept distinct from the actual first construction day, which the release does not state, so occurredOn stays null. The statement does not establish disbursement of any specific financing instrument; the equity row is cross-referenced, not evidenced.

scopeAsStated: early works program at the Marathon copper-palladium project
locator: Opening paragraphs of the 1 October 2026 Generation Mining release
statementOriginal: Early works have commenced following the posting of the construction phase financial assurance under the Project's filed Closure Plan.
statementEn: Early works have commenced following the posting of the construction phase financial assurance under the Project's filed Closure Plan.
note: Issuer statement published 1 October 2026; it establishes that early works had begun by that date, not the first day of work, so occurredOn stays null. The scope is the bounded early-works programme, not construction of the full mine. The Canada Growth Fund equity row is cross-referenced only: this milestone does not date, condition or evidence any CGF disbursement, and no financing causality is inferred.

scopeAsStated: initial commercial rare-earth sintered magnet production programs at Neo's European permanent magnet facility in Narva, Estonia
locator: Issuer announcement September 14, 2026; opening body paragraph
statementOriginal: its European permanent magnet manufacturing facility is in commercial production and shipping volumes of rare earth sintered magnets
statementEn: its European permanent magnet manufacturing facility is in commercial production and shipping volumes of rare earth sintered magnets
note: Issuer reports initial commercial sintered-magnet program and shipments as of 2026-09-14, but does not state the first production-start day. Do not treat publication day as an occurredOn event; no observed 2,000-tonne output, Phase 1B/20,000-tonne achievement, JTF-caused production, or disbursement inference.

scopeAsStated: Burntlog Route access road and associated 2026 critical-path works
locator: June 1 announcement, first paragraph following project update introduction
statementOriginal: On Saturday, May 30, Perpetua commenced additional critical path construction activities for the 2026 field season
statementEn: On Saturday, May 30, Perpetua commenced additional critical path construction activities for the 2026 field season
note: Issuer statement dating the start of the Burntlog/2026 critical-path workstream to 30 May 2026. This row supersedes the taxonomy-blocked M3.2 framing by recording a bounded workstream, separate from the October 2025 early works; it is not the start of whole-mine construction. DPA and EXIM rows are cross-referenced because they cite the same source; dating their implementation histories is deferred until the instrument/project-status relationship is independently reconciled. No financing causality is inferred.

scopeAsStated: early works construction for the Stibnite Gold Project
locator: October 21, 2025 original issuer release, attributed CEO Jon Cherry quote, paragraph 2
statementOriginal: we officially started early works construction today
statementEn: we officially started early works construction today
note: Issuer release of 21 October 2025; the attributed CEO quotation dates the start of early-works construction to that day. The scope is the early-works workstream only, separate from the 30 May 2026 Burntlog workstream and from whole-mine construction, commissioning or production. The release says financial assurance was posted from cash on hand and describes the preliminary EXIM letter as nonbinding; no financing causality is inferred.

scopeAsStated: Thompson Falls, Montana antimony processing and refining facility expansion
locator: Form 10-Q Note 9, Government Grant, substantial-completion and PP&E paragraph; corroborating Note 16, Thompson Falls, Montana Facility Expansion
statementOriginal: The Thompson Falls facility expansion was substantially completed
statementEn: The Thompson Falls facility expansion was substantially completed
note: USAC's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports the expansion substantially completed, $4.1M in related assets placed in service late Q2, and ~$29M gross project costs still in construction in progress at June 30. The exact progress day, full commissioning, design throughput and closure of every grant-funded workstream remain unknown. April $12.8M cash, the $20M Thompson Falls child allocation, the $27M parent and ~$39M corporate expansion budget have distinct accounting bases. Its finance row cites this same 10-Q for construction status: no independent confirmation. This is a reported construction snapshot, not a completed/operating project or a dated start event.

scopeAsStated: commercial magnet production line (Phase 1a) at its facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma
locator: Opening paragraph of the 26 March 2026 GlobeNewswire release
statementOriginal: today announced the successful commissioning of its commercial magnet production line (Phase 1a) at its facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma.
statementEn: today announced the successful commissioning of its commercial magnet production line (Phase 1a) at its facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma.
note: Issuer announcement published 26 March 2026; it reports commissioning of the Phase 1a line, not sustained commercial output, design throughput or customer deliveries, and the commissioning day itself is not stated, so occurredOn stays null. The milestone is not attributed to CHIPS or any other public financing.
